meta.note: Extracted from public/index.html, then redesigned after a UI/UX review (see ux-review.md).

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background and the ground of every section.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Recessed fills: stat cards, callouts, the footer, empty states, region tiles.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Panels that sit on surface: the source disclosure panel, menus.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines, body copy and numbers on bg, surface and surface-raised. 18:1 light, 15.9:1 dark.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Standfirsts, summaries and descriptions on bg and surface. ≥7.9:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Meta lines: source, base date, captions, on bg and surface. ≥5.2:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers between list rows and around cards only. Never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of chips, inputs and secondary buttons. ≥3.1:1 on bg and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Taegeuk blue: links, section labels, the active nav item, primary buttons, the focus ring, semiconductor bars. 8.7:1 light, 8.1:1 dark on bg.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of brand fills and links.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: AI summary box and selected-row tint. brand and ink-2 text both read on it (≥6.4:1).

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill (primary button, pressed region tile, AI tag). Dark text in dark theme because brand lightens there.

tokens.name: hl
tokens.usage: Amber accent: traditional industries (steel, shipbuilding, autos, petrochemicals, energy) and their top rule. 6:1 light, 10.3:1 dark on bg.

tokens.name: hl-soft
tokens.usage: Issue notice band (prototype issue, collection limits). ink text on it.

tokens.name: head
tokens.usage: Masthead band. Black in both themes; it is the paper's nameplate.

tokens.name: head-ink
tokens.usage: Wordmark, date and the text-size toggle on head. 18.9:1.

tokens.name: head-line
tokens.usage: Outline of controls inside the masthead.

tokens.name: bar
tokens.usage: Neutral data bars (items that are neither semiconductor nor traditional industry). Darkened from #a7b0bc so a bar holds 3:1 on bg.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error state text and icon only: a failed issue load. Never for a falling number; direction stays neutral.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Error state background; danger and ink text on it.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 3px focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element. ≥8:1 on bg; on head use head-ink.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Categorical series 1 (overseas equities, semiconductor).

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Categorical series 2 (domestic equities, traditional industry).

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Categorical series 3. ≥4.8:1 on bg and surface.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Categorical series 4.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Categorical series 5.

tokens.name: chart-6
tokens.usage: Categorical series 6. Always pair series with a labelled legend list.

families.sans: "Noto Sans KR", "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif

styles.name: display-1
styles.sample: 코스피, 지난주 14.46% 하락 뒤 3.17% 내린 출발
styles.usage: Lead headline only, one per issue. Fluid: clamp(1.7rem, 4.4vw, 2.6rem).

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Panel titles under a 3px ink rule.

styles.name: num-xl
styles.usage: One headline number per panel (term day, debt). Always tabular-nums.

styles.name: num-lg
styles.usage: Stat card and lead fact values.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: Standfirst under the lead headline, in ink-2.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: 두 숫자 모두 계산은 맞고 출발점만 다릅니다.
styles.usage: Default copy. 1rem = 17px, 18px from 900px, 21px in large-text mode.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section labels, kickers, nav items, button text.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Source and date lines in ink-3.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Smallest text in the system (13.6px). Legends, badges, chart notes. Nothing goes below it.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside a card's stacked lines; chip row gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: List row padding (news, key-value, D-Day).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, grid gap of tiles.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between a section header and its content.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Column gap of two- and three-column layouts.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Section padding top and bottom.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Page side gutter, plus safe-area inset.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Data bars and legend swatches.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, tags, inputs-in-panels, the masthead toggle.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, callouts, accordions, region tiles.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, the search field, progress tracks.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Row dividers in line, control outlines in line-strong.

tokens.name: border-rule
tokens.usage: The newspaper rule: ink above lead facts and panel titles, brand under the active nav item, hl above industry blocks.

tokens.name: border-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring width; offset 2px.

tokens.name: fs
tokens.usage: Root font size under 900px.

tokens.name: fs-wide
tokens.usage: Root font size from 900px.

tokens.name: fs-big
tokens.usage: Root font size when the reader turns on large text (html.big).

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height of anything tappable, including the source button (was 28px).

tokens.name: nav-h
tokens.usage: Top category bar height; also the scroll offset of sections.

tokens.name: tabbar-h
tokens.usage: Bottom tab bar height under 860px, before the safe-area inset.

tokens.name: wrap
tokens.usage: Max content width.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max line length for prose (section descriptions, standfirsts).

tokens.name: shadow-sticky
tokens.usage: Only on the sticky category bar and tab bar once the page has scrolled. Everything else is flat: rules, not shadows.
